questions.q: Which structures are shown in this slide?
options: Two excretory ducts of a salivary gland
questions.explain: Two tubes with concentric layered walls lying together in loose connective tissue fit an artery and vein.
questions.alt: Two vessels lie side by side in loose connective tissue: one with a thick purple wall and round lumen, one with a thinner folded wall and wider lumen.

questions.q: Which feature marks the artery in this pair?
options: A thick wall with a prominent muscular layer around a round lumen
A thin wall with a wide collapsed lumen
A wall of a single flat cell layer only
questions.explain: Arteries have a thicker tunica media and keep a round lumen.
questions.alt: Two vessels lie side by side in loose connective tissue: one with a thick purple wall and round lumen, one with a thinner folded wall and wider lumen.

questions.q: Which layer is usually the thickest in a medium-sized vein?
questions.explain: Veins have a thinner media and a relatively thick adventitia.
